complex_logic: A monetary arithmetic core that represents amounts as integer cents in arbitrary-precision integers, refuses decimal strings carrying more than two fraction digits, rounds scaled ratios half upward, and bounds every operation against an overflow limit.

A shared request defence layer combining per-endpoint fixed-window throttling keyed on proxy-supplied client addresses, rejection of oversized declared bodies without reading them, environment-dependent origin validation, and periodic pruning so the bucket store cannot grow unbounded.
work_units: Replace the single-process fixed-window request throttle with a limiter that stays correct across several server instances and restarts, preserving per-endpoint budgets, accurate retry-after reporting, atomic counting under concurrency, and bounded memory.

Make visitor event ingestion idempotent and loss-tolerant by deduplicating retried beacons on a client-supplied key, batching writes, and reconciling the funnel so a later stage can never report more entries than the one above it.

Extend the money arithmetic into a currency-aware formatter and converter handling currencies with zero or three fractional digits, locale-specific grouping and sign placement, and right-to-left rendering, while guaranteeing exact round-tripping in every case.

Build a behavioural test harness for the lead intake path against a disposable database and stubbed notification and payment providers, asserting validation rejections, throttle responses, oversized-body rejection, and the partial-failure path where a record persists but notification fails.

Implement a byte-range aware media proxy that validates and normalizes incoming range requests, handles unsatisfiable and multiple ranges, propagates partial-content status and length headers correctly, and streams the payload without buffering it in memory.
net_new_capabilities: A payment reconciliation and entitlement subsystem that verifies signed provider callbacks, grants premium access idempotently under duplicate and out-of-order delivery, handles refunds and disputes, and keeps a ledger reconciling charges against granted access.

A listing catalogue with a verification workflow moving owner-submitted assets through intake, document checks, approval and publication states, with per-state permissions, reviewer assignment and an audit trail, replacing the hard-coded showcase items.

An investment return model built on the precise arithmetic, compounding over a chosen horizon with per-market growth assumptions, acquisition and holding costs, taxes and fees, and producing sensitivity ranges instead of a single slider-derived estimate.

A role and permission model replacing the single hard-coded owner comparison, with distinct operator, agent and viewer capabilities, per-resource authorisation, invitation and revocation flows, and audit logging of privileged reads.

A market price ingestion pipeline polling several feeds on a schedule, normalizing currencies and units, versioning cached snapshots, detecting stale or contradictory sources, and serving historical series to the price board.

A lead scoring and routing engine deriving intent and urgency from conversation transcripts and browsing behaviour, deduplicating people across chat, voice and form entries, assigning an owner, and escalating on a timed follow-up schedule.

A conversation persistence and handoff layer keeping concierge context across sessions and devices, summarizing long threads to stay within model input limits, and transferring a visitor to a human with the transcript intact.

A search and ranking surface over asset inventory with structured filters on price, location and type, relevance ordering, pagination that stays stable while inventory changes, and query handling across every supported language.

A localization pipeline moving interface strings out of inline dictionaries, supporting plural and gender-aware forms, right-to-left layout and alternative numeral systems, and falling back per missing string rather than per language.

An appointment scheduler for viewings and test drives with availability windows across time zones, double-booking prevention, confirmations and reminders, cancellation and rescheduling rules, and reconciliation against external calendars.

A consent and data-retention subsystem covering visitor tracking, lead records and conversation transcripts, with regional consent gating, export and erasure handling, and automatic expiry of stale personal information.
hardening_work: A defensive layer applied across the public write endpoints giving each its own throttle budget, rejecting oversized declared bodies before reading, and constraining payment return destinations to a validated secure origin so the redirect cannot be steered elsewhere.
integration_work: An external market feed adapter tolerating several response envelope shapes and field aliases, coercing mixed-type numbers, defaulting currency and trend direction, discarding incomplete records, and separating timeout, upstream failure and unsupported-shape conditions into distinct client outcomes.

A browser voice agent integration that fetches its own enablement and public credential at runtime, refuses to initialise when unconfigured, probes and releases microphone permission before starting, tracks call lifecycle events, and degrades to a callback form.

material.material_summary: A multilingual marketplace front end for luxury property and rare cars, built around lead capture, visitor event tracking, a conversational sales concierge in both text and voice, owner-only reporting, and a single paid access product. The two pieces of genuinely careful engineering are an exact integer-cent arithmetic core with a boundary-focused test suite, and a shared request defence layer covering throttling, body-size limits and origin validation. Almost everything else is presentation, validation schemas and thin adapters onto hosted services.
